phases.objective: Provide an exact-head, read-only dispatcher with a trusted issue-comment command that delegates bounded generated-artifact mutation to the already registered workflow without becoming a pull-request write workflow, checking out candidate code, or writing repository contents directly.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted repository collaborator and repository automation
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted PR comment in the exact form /refresh-generated-artifacts <40-character SHA>, a governed work-branch push, or an explicit workflow dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher verifies a trusted comment author, exact typed SHA, same-repository pull request, required generated-artifact-refresh label, and current head; then delegates to governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml with typed confirmation and publishes structured evidence without checking out candidate code or writing repository contents directly.
steps: Accept newly created issue comments only when they belong to a pull-request conversation.
Require OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR author association.
Parse exactly /refresh-generated-artifacts followed by one lowercase 40-character SHA.
Read the pull request from the GitHub API without checking out candidate code.
Reject cross-repository heads and reject a typed SHA that differs from the current PR head.
Validate the governed target branch and exact current head SHA.
Resolve exactly one open same-repository pull request for the target branch.
Require the generated-artifact-refresh label and matching pull-request head.
Dispatch the registered mutating workflow on main with target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH.
Publish JSON and Markdown evidence before enforcing the structured decision.
assertions: The write-capable dispatcher is not triggered by pull_request or pull_request_target.
The dispatcher never checks out pull-request candidate code.
The comment command is accepted only from OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR.
The comment command binds the exact current PR head SHA.
The dispatcher rejects fork or cross-repository heads through API readback.
The dispatcher has actions: write but contents: read, issues: read, and pull-requests: read only.
The dispatcher contains no git push and performs no direct repository mutation.
main and Production are rejected before API dispatch.
Bot-authored generated commits do not recursively dispatch.
Job logs are diagnostic-only and the report declares consult_job_logs=false and secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Publish dispatch evidence through the canonical PR evidence publisher.
Exercise stale typed SHA, untrusted author association, API rejection, ambiguous PR, cross-repository, and artifact upload failures.
Observe the first non-production exact-head dispatch from the trusted PR comment command.
Keep protected branches and untrusted candidate code outside direct mutation authority.
